verdict.rationale: Inngest documents a first-party testing library that mocks function state, step tooling and inputs through a Jest-compatible API, and community users praise a local development server and local mode. However, no first-party evidence shows a single command running the whole engine locally, and time skipping in tests is not documented. Missing for 10: documented one-command local engine startup, time-skipping test utilities, independent corroboration of the testing library.

support.subject: As a backend developer, one command runs the whole engine locally, and testing utilities let me unit-test workflows with time skipping and mocked steps

citations.quote: This allows you to mock function state, step tooling, and inputs with a Jest-compatible API supporting all major testing frameworks, runtimes, and libraries
The development server is neat and makes debugging jobs very easy.
Thanks so much for all the work and enabling a local mode too.
